subject: [PATCH v3 1/8] nfsd: Report vetted delegated timestamps in GETATTR replies

2026-11-09.patch_summary: This patch fixes a bug in the NFS server where it incorrectly reports delegated timestamps to clients. The issue arises when the server receives a CB_GETATTR reply, which contains raw time_deleg_access and time_deleg_modify values that have not been vetted for validity. These values are then overridden by the server, causing incorrect timestamps to be reported to the client. This patch removes the override, ensuring that only vetted delegated timestamps are returned in GETATTR responses.
